lines.text: Die in GTA 6 with your pockets full, and that cash can be gone for good.
Guides say cash you carry is lost when you die or get arrested.
It only counts once you deposit it at an ATM.
Mistake two: your pockets cap out at twenty thousand dollars!
Mistake three: stealing the first car you see.
A phone scanner shows its security, trackers, and resale value first.
Check before you steal, and you keep more of your money.
